```{r}
# Average land price by township/district
hsinchu <- list("j_lvr_land_a.csv", "o_lvr_land_a.csv") %>%
lapply(function(file) {

df <- real_estate_data[[file]]

# Promote first row to header
colnames(df) <- as.character(unlist(df[1, ]))
df <- df[-1, , drop = FALSE]

# Select by name (more stable than column index)
df %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
    "The villages and towns urban district",
    "main use",
    "the unit price (NTD / square meter)"
  )))

}) %>%
bind_rows()

hsinchu <- hsinchu %>%
  filter(`main use` %in% c("住家用", "住商用", "住工用")) %>%
  rename(TOWNNAME = `The villages and towns urban district`) %>%
  rename(LANDPRICE = `the unit price (NTD / square meter)`)

hsinchu_ave_price <- hsinchu %>%
group_by(TOWNNAME) %>%
summarise(
avg_price = mean(parse_number(LANDPRICE), na.rm = TRUE),
.groups = "drop"
)

price_to_copy <- hsinchu_ave_price %>%
filter(TOWNNAME == "新竹市") %>%
pull(avg_price) %>%
first()

if (length(price_to_copy) == 1 && !is.na(price_to_copy)) {
hsinchu_ave_price <- hsinchu_ave_price %>%
add_row(
TOWNNAME = c("北區", "香山區", "東區"),
avg_price = price_to_copy
) %>%
filter(TOWNNAME != "新竹市")
}

hsinchu_ave_price
```

```{r}
hsinchu_pop_data <- aging_data %>%
filter(COUNTY %in% c("新竹縣", "新竹市")) %>%
select(any_of(c("COUNTY", "TOWN", "A65UP_A15A64_RAT"))) %>%
mutate(
A65UP_A15A64_RAT = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(A65UP_A15A64_RAT))
) %>%
rename(TOWNNAME = TOWN)

hsinchu_pop_data
```

```{r}
standardize_cols <- function(df) {
df %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
}
```

```{r}
df_med <- bind_rows(
medical_data$medical_center %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "醫學中心"),
medical_data$hospital_regional %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "區域醫院"),
medical_data$hospital_local %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "地區醫院"),
medical_data$clinic %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "診所"),
medical_data$pharmacy %>% standardize_cols() %>% mutate(Level = "藥局")
)
```

```{r}
medical_summary <- df_med %>%
mutate(
地址 = iconv(地址, from = "UTF-8", to = "UTF-8", sub = ""),
地址 = str_replace_all(地址, "台", "臺"),
Region = str_extract(地址, "^.{2,3}?[縣市]"),
Address_Clean = str_remove(地址, "^.{2,3}?[縣市]"),
District = str_extract(Address_Clean, "^.+?[區鄉鎮市]"),
Weight = case_when(
Level == "醫學中心" ~ 10,
Level == "區域醫院" ~ 5,
Level == "地區醫院" ~ 3,
Level == "診所" ~ 1,
Level == "藥局" ~ 0.5,
TRUE ~ 0
)
) %>%
filter(!is.na(Region), !is.na(District)) %>%
group_by(Region, District) %>%
summarise(
Medical_Score = sum(Weight, na.rm = TRUE),
Facility_Count = n(),
.groups = "drop"
)

medical_hsinchu <- medical_summary %>%
filter(Region %in% c("新竹市", "新竹縣"))
```

```{r}
land_hsinchu <- hsinchu_ave_price %>%
mutate(
District = TOWNNAME,
Region = if_else(District %in% c("北區", "香山區", "東區"), "新竹市", "新竹縣")
) %>%
select(Region, District, avg_price)
```

```{r}
aging_hsinchu <- hsinchu_pop_data %>%
mutate(
Region = COUNTY,
District = TOWNNAME
) %>%
select(Region, District, A65UP_A15A64_RAT)
```

```{r}
medical_hsinchu <- medical_hsinchu %>%
select(Region, District, Medical_Score, Facility_Count)
```

```{r}
hsinchu_core <- aging_hsinchu %>%
inner_join(land_hsinchu, by = c("Region", "District")) %>%
left_join(medical_hsinchu, by = c("Region", "District")) %>%
mutate(
Medical_Score = replace_na(Medical_Score, 0),
Facility_Count = replace_na(Facility_Count, 0)
)

hsinchu_core
```

```{r}
hsinchu_core <- hsinchu_core %>%
mutate(
avg_price = if_else(is.finite(avg_price) & avg_price > 0, avg_price, NA_real_),
Log_Price = log(avg_price),
Log_Medical = log(Medical_Score + 1),
Aging_Burden = A65UP_A15A64_RAT
) %>%
filter(
is.finite(Log_Price),
is.finite(Log_Medical),
!is.na(Aging_Burden)
)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# Taipei City: Price vs Aging scatter (by district)
# =========================

library(ggrepel)

# --- 1) Average land price by district (Taipei City) ---
taipei <- list("a_lvr_land_a.csv") %>%
  lapply(function(file) {
    df <- real_estate_data[[file]]

    # Promote first row to header
    colnames(df) <- as.character(unlist(df[1, ]))
    df <- df[-1, , drop = FALSE]

    df %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
        "The villages and towns urban district",
        "main use",
        "the unit price (NTD / square meter)"
      )))
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

taipei <- taipei %>%
  filter(`main use` %in% c("住家用", "住商用", "住工用")) %>%
  rename(
    District = `The villages and towns urban district`,
    LANDPRICE = `the unit price (NTD / square meter)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    District = str_replace_all(District, "台", "臺") # unify 台/臺 just in case
  )

taipei_ave_price <- taipei %>%
  group_by(District) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_price = mean(parse_number(LANDPRICE), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Region = "臺北市"
  ) %>%
  select(Region, District, avg_price)

# --- 2) Aging index by district (Taipei City) ---
aging_taipei <- aging_data %>%
  filter(COUNTY %in% c("臺北市", "台北市")) %>%
  mutate(
    COUNTY = str_replace_all(COUNTY, "台", "臺")
  ) %>%
  select(any_of(c("COUNTY", "TOWN", "A65UP_A15A64_RAT"))) %>%
  mutate(
    A65UP_A15A64_RAT = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(A65UP_A15A64_RAT)),
    TOWN = str_replace_all(TOWN, "台", "臺")
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Region = COUNTY,
    District = TOWN
  ) %>%
  select(Region, District, A65UP_A15A64_RAT)

# --- 3) Join core + clean for plotting ---
taipei_core <- aging_taipei %>%
  inner_join(taipei_ave_price, by = c("Region", "District")) %>%
  mutate(
    avg_price = if_else(is.finite(avg_price) & avg_price > 0, avg_price, NA_real_),
    Aging_Burden = A65UP_A15A64_RAT
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Aging_Burden),
    is.finite(avg_price)
  )

# --- 4) Scatter plot ---
taipei_scatter_df <- taipei_core %>%
  transmute(
    Region = factor(Region, levels = c("臺北市")),
    District,
    Aging_Index = Aging_Burden,
    Avg_Price = avg_price
  )

p_taipei_price_vs_aging <- ggplot(
  taipei_scatter_df,
  aes(x = Aging_Index, y = Avg_Price)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = District),
    size = 3.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.25,
    segment.alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) {
    if (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) <= 1) {
      scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.1)(x)
    } else {
      scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01)(x)
    }
  }) +
  labs(
    title = "Taipei City: Real Estate Price vs Aging Index (by District)",
    x = "Aging Index (A65UP_A15A64_RAT)",
    y = "Average Land Price (NTD per m²)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p_taipei_price_vs_aging


```

# =========================
# Taipei City: Price vs Aging scatter (English labels)
# =========================

library(ggrepel)

region_en <- c(
  "臺北市" = "Taipei City"
)

district_en <- c(
  "松山區" = "Songshan District",
  "信義區" = "Xinyi District",
  "大安區" = "Da'an District",
  "中山區" = "Zhongshan District",
  "中正區" = "Zhongzheng District",
  "大同區" = "Datong District",
  "萬華區" = "Wanhua District",
  "文山區" = "Wenshan District",
  "南港區" = "Nangang District",
  "內湖區" = "Neihu District",
  "士林區" = "Shilin District",
  "北投區" = "Beitou District"
)

taipei <- list("a_lvr_land_a.csv") %>%
  lapply(function(file) {
    df <- real_estate_data[[file]]

    # Promote first row to header
    colnames(df) <- as.character(unlist(df[1, ]))
    df <- df[-1, , drop = FALSE]

    df %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
        "The villages and towns urban district",
        "main use",
        "the unit price (NTD / square meter)"
      )))
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

taipei <- taipei %>%
  filter(`main use` %in% c("住家用", "住商用", "住工用")) %>%
  rename(
    District = `The villages and towns urban district`,
    LANDPRICE = `the unit price (NTD / square meter)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    District = str_replace_all(District, "台", "臺")
  )

taipei_ave_price <- taipei %>%
  group_by(District) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_price = mean(parse_number(LANDPRICE), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Region = "臺北市"
  ) %>%
  select(Region, District, avg_price)

aging_taipei <- aging_data %>%
  filter(COUNTY %in% c("臺北市", "台北市")) %>%
  mutate(
    COUNTY = str_replace_all(COUNTY, "台", "臺")
  ) %>%
  select(any_of(c("COUNTY", "TOWN", "A65UP_A15A64_RAT"))) %>%
  mutate(
    A65UP_A15A64_RAT = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(A65UP_A15A64_RAT)),
    TOWN = str_replace_all(TOWN, "台", "臺")
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Region = COUNTY,
    District = TOWN
  ) %>%
  select(Region, District, A65UP_A15A64_RAT)

taipei_core <- aging_taipei %>%
  inner_join(taipei_ave_price, by = c("Region", "District")) %>%
  mutate(
    avg_price = if_else(is.finite(avg_price) & avg_price > 0, avg_price, NA_real_),
    Aging_Burden = A65UP_A15A64_RAT,
    Region_EN = dplyr::recode(Region, !!!region_en, .default = as.character(Region)),
    District_EN = dplyr::recode(District, !!!district_en, .default = as.character(District))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Aging_Burden),
    is.finite(avg_price)
  )

taipei_scatter_df_en <- taipei_core %>%
  transmute(
    Region = factor(Region_EN, levels = c("Taipei City")),
    District = District_EN,
    Aging_Index = Aging_Burden,
    Avg_Price = avg_price
  )

p_taipei_price_vs_aging_en <- ggplot(
  taipei_scatter_df_en,
  aes(x = Aging_Index, y = Avg_Price)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = District),
    size = 3.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.25,
    segment.alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) {
    if (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) <= 1) {
      scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.1)(x)
    } else {
      scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01)(x)
    }
  }) +
  labs(
    title = "Taipei City: Real Estate Price vs Aging Index (by District)",
    x = "Aging Index (65+/15–64 ratio)",
    y = "Average Land Price (NTD per m²)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p_taipei_price_vs_aging_en
